pp2.9:1.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhati tattha ca sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇāti phalesu ca vasībhāvaṃ:
pp2.9:2.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhati na ca tattha sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇāti na ca phalesu vasībhāvaṃ:
pp2.9:3.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo aṭṭha vimokkhe kāyena phusitvā viharati paññāya c' assa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti:
pp2.9:4.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo na h' eva kho aṭṭha vimokkhe kāyena phusitvā viharati paññāya c' assa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti:
pp2.9:5.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo aṭṭha vimokkhe kāyena phusitvā viharati paññāya c' assa disvā ekacce āsavā parikkhīṇā honti:
pp2.9:6.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . pe . . .
pp2.9:6.3: ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, Tathāgatappaveditā c' assa dhammā paññāya vo diṭṭhā honti vo caritā, paññāya c' assa disvā ekacce āsavā parikkhīṇā honti:
pp2.9:7.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . pe . . .
pp2.9:7.3: [see I. 34] parikkhīṇā honti no ca kho yathā diṭṭhippattassa:
pp2.9:8.4: paṭipanno puggalo dhammānusārī phale ṭhito diṭṭhippatto.
pp2.9:9.4: paṭipanno puggalo saddhānusārī phale ṭhito saddhāvimutto.
